system.description:
You remain resilient against attacks that target your vitality, making it difficult for enemies to sap your strength.

Prerequisite: Gamorrean

Effect: Whenever an attack or Skill Check targets your Fortitude Defense and fails to equal or exceed it, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude Defense until the start of your next turn.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
